annotations.title: What's waiting for the person to do by hand

description: The tasks waiting in the person's approvals for something only they can do (a store console's form, a declaration, Google's first production release in Play Console), the ones Ploa filed itself when a store stopped a request and the ones agents asked for: each with its numbered steps, their links, and its address in Ploa. Call it after a store refuses or holds something (a release left as a draft, App Review's refusal), and whenever the person asks what's left. Walk them through each in chat, step by step with the links, and give each task's address. Read-only.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
